item.title: Bridging the Gap: Implementing GitOps Bridge Pattern with Kind
item.description: As I reflect on my journey implementing the GitOps Bridge pattern, I’ve learned that it’s not just another technical solution, it’s a fundamental shift in how we manage our Kubernetes infrastructure. My experience began with a simple goal: to bridge the gap between creating Kubernetes clusters and managing them through GitOps. Traditional approaches to Kubernetes management often create a disconnect between two critical phases: the infrastructure provisioning, where you create and configure the Kubernetes clusters using an IaC tool like terraform, and the addons/application management, where you deploy the required applications within those clusters: monitoring, compliance and security addons.
